Grow your own

The association looks after ninety plots on the old water meadow, and lets them to people who live in the parish. Members grow vegetables, fruit and flowers for their own tables, and share what is left over at the gate. This is where you can find out how the site is run, what it costs and how to take on a plot of your own.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
